subject: POC environment gatekeepers — preflight checklist & MAP milestones
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC environment gatekeepers — preflight checklist & MAP milestones

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discovery, I sketched a short Mutual Action Plan focused on the POC environment gatekeepers so we can lock a target start date. High-level milestones and owners below; attached is "redwood-proposed-map-v1.xlsx" with the milestone table.

Key POC gatekeepers (items we agreed would need sign-off/config):
- VPC peering / routing (static route + shared subnet) — Owner: ClarityAI infra (Aaron)
- IP allowlist for control plane & management IPs — Owner: ClarityAI network ops
- SSO / SAML metadata exchange + IdP testing — Owner: ClarityAI SSO admin (Elena), Redwood to provide SP metadata
- Secrets / KMS integration (customer-managed key or cross-account access) — Owner: Redwood/Security (Camila)
- SOC2 evidence & access request (read-only logs) — Owner: ClarityAI security

Target dates (proposed):
- Contract signature: 2026-11-30
- Infra readiness (VPC peering + allowlists): 2026-12-10
- SSO smoke test: 2026-12-14
- KMS/secrets handoff + verification: 2026-12-16
- POC go-live (restricted traffic): 2026-12-20

Open dependencies I flagged for Redwood:
1) We'll need your SAML IdP metadata and a test account (SAML assertion) at least 3 business days before the smoke test. I attached a saml-metadata-template.xml you can populate if helpful.
2) For KMS — please confirm whether you must use your KMS (customer-managed) or if a scoped cross-account key is acceptable. If using customer-managed, we'll need a contact for KMS admin to coordinate IAM bindings.
3) Provide the list of management IPs to be allowlisted (or an ASN if dynamic).

Next steps I propose:
- Aaron / Elena: reply with owners and an availability window for a 30-min infra preflight (this week) — we can use it to walk the peering/allowlist specifics.
- Camila: will share the KMS integration doc and a short checklist for required IAM roles.
- Ben: will update the HubSpot MAP and set the milestone target dates if we agree.

If this aligns, we'll mark the MAP as v1 and send a DocuSign for the SOW/committed start date.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the infra greenlighted.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clarityai.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@clarityai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC environment gatekeepers — preflight checklist & MAP milestones

Hi Avery —

Thanks for the clear summary. This looks close to what our security/infra team needs. A few clarifications from our side:

- Aaron will own the VPC peering and route configuration; we can confirm subnet ranges by EOD 11/20.
- For IP allowlists: security requests a small range of management IPs and would prefer using our gateway egress IPs if possible. We'll send the list in the follow-up.
- SSO: I can provide our IdP metadata (Okta) and two test accounts. ETA for metadata: 11/20 morning.
- KMS: We must use our customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault). We'll need a Redwood integration pattern for Azure Key Vault usage — can Camila share the guidance?
- SOC2 evidence: our compliance team will ask for a SOC2 report and a brief explanation of your audit log retention and export process before we allow any production data. Is there a standard packet you can share?

Timeline constraints: our procurement team requires the SOW signed by 11/30 for the quarter close, and we can target infra readiness by 12/15 instead of 12/10 if additional approvals are needed.

Happy to hop on a short preflight call with Aaron and your infra lead tomorrow at 10:30 PT if that works.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering
ClarityAI
elena@clarityai.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
